Question 2

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with velocity v(t)=3t2+2t, where t is the time. If the particle is at the position x=15 when t=2, calculate the position x of the particle at time t>0.

a
x(t)=t3+t2
b
x(t)=4t+7
c
x(t)=t3+t2+3
d
x(t)=6t+3
e
x(t)=t3+t2−5
